method: Read relevant formation and use sections in independent authored teaching sources. Compare conflicting absolutes rather than imposing them. All examples, dialogues, essays, notices and task keys are original AI-assisted drafts. Restricted JMdict checks verify 54 pairs, not official levels or naturalness.

points.formation: Dictionary verb + まじき + noun; commonly role + にあるまじき + 行為. Marked する→すまじき recognised.
points.teachingChoice: Strong formal condemnation of an act relative to a role or standard, not physical impossibility. Friends quote an editorial about a fabricated interview; a corrected date error is a separate person and incident. No routine learner-error shaming or uncorroborated classical derivation.

points.form: ともなると / ともなれば
points.formation: Noun / dictionary verb + ともなると/ともなれば + an assessed consequence at a significant role/scale/stage.
points.teachingChoice: Larger hall staffing and responsibilities establish the contextual assessment. Contrast a direct wish/request in this taught frame, not a universal staffing rule, age/season stereotype or inevitable result.

points.formation: Noun identifying a particular case + に至っては + especially striking, usually negative result within the established wider comparison.
points.teachingChoice: Date and name errors precede the even worse reversed entry/exit map. Distinguish from stage-reaching に至って and despite-reaching に至っても; do not teach a context-free interchangeable gap.

points.form: をもって / をもちまして
points.formation: Formal boundary (closing here) or formal means, determined by the preceding noun and whole predicate.
points.teachingChoice: Current exhibition viewing closes at six; next-event applications close at five. 書面 specifies notification means, not a time or required seal. Everyday specific tools often take plain で. Do not adopt Bunpro’s absolute starting-boundary prohibition: its own appointment examples complicate that claim. This unit teaches closing and means only.
